notes.title: Lucky Island version update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/dec39055a3e6b6dda4673b68ff83edc97ee6ba34.png[/img]
Lucky Island version update
Updated version: v1.1.0

This update focuses on improving the dispatch mode of island residents, solving the original idle phenomenon and unpredictable work sequence, and has made significant improvements.

1. Optimize the AI ​​of island residents
Improved resident work patterns: All islanders will now be more engaged in work and the workload will be more evenly distributed. Those residents who have previously worked less often will be given priority to ensure that no resident is idle.
Prioritize the shortest path: The work sequence will be optimized based on the length of the path that islanders take to reach the work location. The islander with the shortest path will start working first, improving overall work efficiency.
2. Adjust the probability of treasure chests
Adjusted the proportion of treasures: Modified the types of treasures obtained from treasure chests, increased the appearance probability of functional buildings, and relatively reduced the frequency of decorative buildings, making it easier for players to obtain practical resources.
3. Fine-tune game details
Fixed errors and prompts: Fixed some error descriptions in the game, and color-coded game prompts to enable players to understand and operate more intuitively.
This update aims to improve the overall game experience and make the world of Lucky Island more interesting and challenging. I hope you all enjoy the changes brought about by this update!

notes.title: [Lucky Island] is officially launched! Build your dream island!
notes.notes:
This is a world full of vitality and infinite possibilities, an island waiting for you to explore. This is "Lucky Island"!
The official version of "Lucky Island" will be officially launched on May 24, 2024, bringing players an adventure full of fun and challenges.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/3c7650055cfd27a19bc3fad780ab87a7ea6c084f.png[/img]

From early access to official launch, complete game development has been completed, and many new features have been added to make "Lucky Island" more colorful. Compared with the early access version, the new additions to the official version of "Lucky Island" include:

1. New game modes: In addition to the original game modes, new easy, casual, expert and challenge modes are added to meet the needs and preferences of different players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/4a4242a5063d65d8b67d849bbd3c5a93f662650f.png[/img]

2. Creative construction mode: Use your architectural talents to show off your creativity and imagination while building islands.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/0f38975f09f2f9654a496b5e500bf2a697c71280.png[/img]

3. Game adjustment function: The function of adjusting the game speed according to the player's game speed is added, so that every player can enjoy the best game experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/a983aa012426483b29a7d037cba81aa89e165347.png[/img]

4. New buildings and slot machine cards: A variety of colorful buildings and slot machine cards are waiting for you to explore, bringing more surprises and challenges to your island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/dad1329fbd9518afd78aa63d520c072158a72bc0.png[/img]

5. Teaching mode and detailed instructions: A new teaching mode and detailed instructions are added to make it easier for novice players to get started and quickly integrate into the game world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/fc9e2dff29ae61d215511be2fccfe5f311ebd3b7.png[/img]

6. STEAM achievement system: Challenge yourself, unlock various achievements, and become a true master of "Lucky Island"!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/92665ad72b62d15879e14e37691ce46357289635.png[/img]

7. Multi-language support: The official version supports four languages: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English and Japanese, allowing more players to play happily.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/03178728fdd74333fb3e15d1d31275ce4ac4a553.png[/img]

game introduction:

This dynamic island management game takes you on an adventure filled with endless possibilities. Featuring a cute pixel style, "Lucky Island" cleverly combines island construction and management with slot machine elements to create a fresh and relaxing gaming experience for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/587b8f7ed5b95711bac0048f2ee582e5052f788c.png[/img]

In "Lucky Island", you will become the island owner and be responsible for building and managing your island. During the day, you will direct the islanders to work and complete various tasks; at night, it is your time to plan the island. You are free to build the island according to your personal preferences and ideas, creating a unique landscape. Through slot machine games, you can better manage your island, provide islanders with better living conditions, and improve work efficiency.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/efa5df7ee819967b08b3e299bb979a0c7fdc6461.png[/img]

Luck is also an important factor in the game, but through your hard work and wisdom, coupled with appropriate resource planning and skill use, you will be able to build the island of your dreams and let the islanders live a happy life. In addition, there are a variety of skills with specific effects for you to use in the game, which can bring different effects and benefits to the island. At the same time, a variety of Rogue-style trigger events also exist in the game, and the rewards obtained may have a positive or negative impact on the island, which requires you to be good at coping and handling.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/d2360e75d020948793bb5c79da92c45625cb622c.png[/img]
Through the combination of island construction, slot machine operation and strategic planning, "Lucky Island" brings you a rich and diverse gaming experience, allowing you to unleash your creativity in the game while challenging your management and strategic abilities. Start your "Lucky Island" adventure now and build your own prosperous island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/5ca83397fecc7a35db9f9c50fc813657f2a919c2.png[/img]
Are you ready? Let’s start this wonderful journey together now!

notes.title: Lucky Island Dev log 7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you for your attention and support. It's time to share the latest game developments and our future plans with all of you.

The development of the game's first playthrough is nearing completion, and we plan to reopen the demo] version in November 2023. Furthermore, Lucky Island is expected to launch with an early access mode in the same month. We will continue to announce further details regarding Lucky Island's release.

Game Feature Updates:
Infinite Island Design: Players can freely create islands of various styles, crafting unique landscapes.
Slot Machine Mode Island Management: We've introduced the concept of slot machines, allowing players to issue work orders to island residents through slot machine games.
Freeform Slot Machine Customization: Players can design and configure their slot machines, adding more diversity to the game.
Various Effects and Skills: Players can use a variety of unique skills to bring different effects and benefits to the island.
Rogue-Style Triggered Events: The game includes a variety of triggered events that may have both positive and negative effects on the island, requiring players to adapt and respond accordingly.
Infinite Variety of Islands: Players can continually construct new islands, expanding activities and developments.

Game Introduction Updates:
Seize the opportunity with a random plane ticket and embark on a fun adventure in Lucky Island. Don't miss this chance to strive to become the world's top island owner!

In Lucky Island, players become island owners, responsible for island construction and management. During the day, you command island residents to work and complete various tasks. In the evening, it's time to plan your island.

Players can freely create their own islands, shaping unique landscapes based on their preferences and ideas. Through the slot machine game, players can manage their islands by timely slot machine designs and skill combinations, enhancing work efficiency for island residents.

In Lucky Island, players can continually construct new islands, expanding activities and developments. Luck is also a significant factor in the game, but through player effort and intelligence, along with proper resource planning and skill usage, you can undoubtedly build your dream island, allowing residents to live a happy and prosperous life.

Furthermore, the game offers a variety of unique skills for players to use, bringing different effects and benefits to the island. At the same time, Rogue-style triggered events are present in the game, potentially causing positive or negative impacts on the island, requiring players to adapt and handle the situations skillfully.

By combining elements such as island construction, slot machine management, and strategic planning, Lucky Island provides players with a rich and diverse gaming experience. You can unleash your creativity in the game while challenging your management and strategic skills. Start your Lucky Island adventure now and create your prosperous island!

notes.title: Lucky Island Demo Game Update - Building Mode
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It has been a week since the release of the Lucky Island demo, and we would like to express our gratitude for your support. We have received valuable feedback from many players, which has allowed us to address various issues and incorporate fantastic suggestions for the future development of Lucky Island.

In our latest update, we are excited to introduce the Building Mode in the demo version, providing players with more opportunities to experience the joy of constructing on Lucky Island.

Here are the key updates in the latest version:

1. Building Movement Feature: You can now freely adjust the position of buildings on the island during the night.
2. News Board Icon Update: The buttons for receiving various quests on the news board have been updated to differentiate between daytime, when quests are available, and nighttime, when they are not.
3. Building Mode (Demo): This mode allows unrestricted construction during the night, regardless of resource limitations. During the day, you can relax and enjoy observing the automated actions of island residents in this leisurely building mode.
4. Card Acquisition Flow Adjustment: We have removed lengthy card acquisition animations to improve gameplay smoothness.
5. Event Trigger Conflict Handling: Several improvements have been made to address game issues arising from the simultaneous triggering of events, quests, slot machines, and the transition to nighttime.

We would like to highlight one important point that has not been explicitly mentioned in the game: for those who need it, please note that the Enter key can activate the slot machine.

Demo Game Introduction:
Allow me to provide a brief overview of the Lucky Island demo game content. The demo version offers players an 8-day game experience, lasting approximately 30-40 minutes. It includes the first stage of island development, with all basic island functionalities fully accessible. However, there are some limitations on the number of triggered events and news board quests. Additionally, the demo version includes the Building Mode for players to enjoy. Please note that the demo does not offer a save function, but the different choices and paths in the game provide unique enjoyment. We will continue to release more activities and updates related to Lucky Island, so stay tuned for further information.

Thank you for your interest in Lucky Island, and we hope you enjoy the demo!

Introduction of Lucky Island Game
Hello everyone, I would like to introduce the game Lucky Island. This is a management game on island. In the automatic island development game, the slot machine is used to add more fun to the island development process. Various events in the rogue style, I hope to bring players a game experience full of surprises.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42848556/79c54138391caf228621ced380ff044e3178798e.png[/img]
Lucky Island time plan
In the current planning of Lucky Island, it is expected to be put on the STEAM platform, and the trial version is planned to be launched in 2023 Q1, and the early access version will be launched in 2023 Q2. It is important from player feedbacks to make Lucky Island get the best possible results. It is plan to be officially launch in 2023 Q3.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42848556/03eb4ea40cc4775bf6b6a8f99887af3b096d3285.png[/img]
Lucky Island Game Architecture
The goal of the Lucky Island game is to complete various island development tasks, and at the same time allocate resources to provide the necessary daily expenditures for the island. The game is mainly divided into two parts, which are the island development time during the day and the island planning at night. 
In the island development time, there is no need for players to assign tasks one by one. Instead, the slot machine is used to set the direction for the development of the island every day. With many unpredictable emergencies, players need to think about how to respond. Adjust the settings of the slot machine in different situations, and choose your favorite configuration among various skills, so that the player's island can develop smoothly. 
In the island planning at night, players can plan their dream island, and try to make the development of the island more smoothly.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42848556/024e38347e9a4ab3791941c8997faf4bd3430c97.png[/img]

Lucky Island Game Features
Unlimited island planning
Automated island management by slot machines
Strategic slot machine design
Rogue-style random events
A variety of skills can be selected

Lucky Island have special elements in a management game to bring players a new game experience. In the brain-burning of planning and strategy, it brings in contrasting automated development and slot machine challenges where luck is king, so that players have unlimited game experience with completely different game methods, whether it is a lucky slot machine expert or a steady working island development, there is a chance to make the island of your dreams and enjoy the fun of the lucky island.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42848556/a5164f13f3dbb26ae82af9f037878a4eb3b84a0f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/4e0bd53ad83a7ec6eae609d82da3daad788a0bf3.png[/img]
Latest news
Lucky Island have a STEAM page now and is under development. Players can add Lucky Island to their wish list to receive news in the STEAM page.
The Lucky Island Discord is open, and all the latest news will be released here. Hope there will be more discussions and suggestion from players. Welcome to the Lucky Island Discord.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/16dc502bdb26e3f4a5fdec207e542752aac54a68.png[/img]
Introduction of Lucky Island Game
Hello everyone, I would like to introduce the game Lucky Island. This is a management game on island. In the automatic island development game, the slot machine is used to add more fun to the island development process. Various events in the rogue style, I hope to bring players a game experience full of surprises.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/b495bdc4e97fa1f16657d87b08376cea4c529593.png[/img]
Lucky Island time plan
In the current planning of Lucky Island, it is expected to be put on the STEAM platform, and the trial version is planned to be launched in 2023 Q1, and the early access version will be launched in 2023 Q2. It is important from player feedbacks to make Lucky Island get the best possible results. It is plan to be officially launch in 2023 Q3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/b495bdc4e97fa1f16657d87b08376cea4c529593.png[/img]
Lucky Island Game Architecture
The goal of the Lucky Island game is to complete various island development tasks, and at the same time allocate resources to provide the necessary daily expenditures for the island. The game is mainly divided into two parts, which are the island development time during the day and the island planning at night. 
In the island development time, there is no need for players to assign tasks one by one. Instead, the slot machine is used to set the direction for the development of the island every day. With many unpredictable emergencies, players need to think about how to respond. Adjust the settings of the slot machine in different situations, and choose your favorite configuration among various skills, so that the player's island can develop smoothly. 
In the island planning at night, players can plan their dream island, and try to make the development of the island more smoothly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/0e7654573fe00ac5fef76d11cdfb466243dfaa49.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/a29f0bd0c7216144c17fda45aec41e3fefbfdecd.png[/img]
Lucky Island Game Features
[list]
[*] Unlimited island planning
[*] Automated island management by slot machines
[*] Strategic slot machine design
[*] Rogue-style random events
[*] A variety of skills can be selected
[/list]
Lucky Island have special elements in a management game to bring players a new game experience. In the brain-burning of planning and strategy, it brings in contrasting automated development and slot machine challenges where luck is king, so that players have unlimited game experience with completely different game methods, whether it is a lucky slot machine expert or a steady working island development, there is a chance to make the island of your dreams and enjoy the fun of the lucky island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/b164ec35c26c6e46678b804d64faaf4be9d62bce.png[/img]
Development progress
The map creation tool has been completed, and a total of about 50 objects created.
The slot machine interface has been completed, and the function of forming tool fragments has been completed, and tool can be assigned to the islanders for working now.
The slot machine element planning function has been completed, and a total of 10 elements have been completed so far.
The islander work function base function is completed, and the work can be received and executed automatically
Bag interface drawing completed
The resource interface is completed, and the resource sales function can work.
The event trigger interface is completed, and the event can also connect to bag with updating the slot machine elements.
